description: This file contains functions and macros for managing cache operations, specifically for flushing cache lines on MIPS architecture in the context of a Linux-based bootloader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes cache control routines and references external cache handling headers.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes cache lines within a specified memory range by performing cache write-back and invalidate operations.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
